title: Homogeneous internal functions with injective underlying coefficients are equivariantly injective
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative condensed ring on a small coherent profinite site [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, def-weil-size-convention]. Let $G$ be a profinite group, write $\underline G(S)=C(S,G)$, and use internal $A$-modules and their internal $G$-actions [sk-def-sfb-module-objects, def-sfb-condensed-action-module]. Let $J$ be such an equivariant module whose underlying internal $A$-module $UJ$ is injective [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. For a condensed set $X$, write $A[X]$ for the free internal $A$-module, left adjoint to forgetting a module to a condensed set. Internal module Hom means the right adjoint of internal tensor [lem-pc-sheaf-modules-tensor-closed]. For each integer $n\geq0$ equip
$$H_n(J)=\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}_A(A[\underline G^{n+1}],UJ)$$
with the action, interpreted after every profinite base change,
$$(g\cdot f)(g_0,\ldots,g_n)=g\cdot_J f(g^{-1}g_0,\ldots,g^{-1}g_n).$$
Then $H_n(J)$ is an injective object in the category of internal $G$-equivariant $A$-modules. No projectivity of the free internal module, discreteness of $J$, or finiteness of $G$ is assumed.
